name.title: DP_RAD750_DDR2_ERROR_LOG
name.sysdesc:
This data product contains data scrubber errors from the RAD750 DDR scrub activity, including error addresses. Note that this will also include errors due to FSW direct access to memory.
Please note that data will be written to this data product only if a scrub error occurs.

field.sysdesc: A complete scrub of RAD750 DDR-2 memory occurs approximately every 55 minutes. This indicates whether a new scrub started this second. This can be used to see which error addresses are persistent between scrub cycles. Even if no errors are detected by the scrubber, an entry will be written to the data product every time this is true.
Number of correctable errors (0-8). The hardware can track up to 8 correctable error addresses, so for each 1Hz cycle, anywhere from 0 to 8 correctable errors may be included.
Number of uncorrectable errors (0-8). The hardware can track up to 8 uncorrectable error addresses, so for each 1Hz cycle, anywhere from 0 to 8 uncorrectable errors may be included.
Number of verification errors (0-1). The hardware can track a single scrub verify error address, so for each 1Hz cycle, either 0 or 1 verify errors may be included.

dynamic_array.sysdesc: Address of a correctable error. Note it is currently TBD how to translate this information to a physical address.

field.sysdesc:
Correctable Error Log (A)
Bits 31:03 Address presented to the PHY for the access with an error Bits 02:01 Reserved Bits 00 The data beat of the error (0 = beat 1, 1 = beat 2)

Correctable Error Log (B) - contains error information for the upper half of the 128-bit MCTL data bus: even nibbles.
Bits 31 1 = This region had a correctable error Bits 30:28 Reserved Bits 27:16 Indicates the nibble in error. Upper 4 bits indicate an ECC nibble, lower 8 bits indicate a data nibble. Bits 15:00 Reserved

Correctable Error Log (C) - contains error information for the upper half of the 128-bit MCTL data bus: odd nibbles.
Bits 31 1 = This region had a correctable error Bits 30:28 Reserved Bits 27:16 Indicates the nibble in error. Upper 4 bits indicate an ECC nibble, lower 8 bits indicate a data nibble. Bits 15:00 Reserved

Correctable Error Log (D) - contains error information for the lower half of the 128-bit MCTL data bus: even nibbles.
Bits 31 1 = This region had a correctable error Bits 30:28 Reserved Bits 27:16 Indicates the nibble in error. Upper 4 bits indicate an ECC nibble, lower 8 bits indicate a data nibble. Bits 15:00 Reserved

Correctable Error Log (E) - contains error information for the lower half of the 128-bit MCTL data bus: odd nibbles.
Bits 31 1 = This region had a correctable error Bits 30:28 Reserved Bits 27:16 Indicates the nibble in error. Upper 4 bits indicate an ECC nibble, lower 8 bits indicate a data nibble. Bits 15:00 Reserved

dynamic_array.sysdesc: Address of a uncorrectable error. Note it is currently TBD how to translate this information to a physical address.

field.sysdesc:
Uncorrectable Error Log (A)
Bits 31:03 Address presented to the PHY for the access with an error Bits 02:01 Reserved Bits 00 The data beat of the error (0 = beat 1, 1 = beat 2)

Uncorrectable Error Log (B)
Bits 31:04 Reserved Bits 03 Upper half odd nibble contained an error Bits 02 Upper half even nibble contained an error Bits 01 Lower half odd nibble contained an error Bits 00 Lower half even nibble contained an error

dynamic_array.sysdesc:

field.sysdesc:
